title: A question sent to both chat and page keeps the same option letters and labels in each, and a stored pick carries its label
why: Owner 12:35 CST Nov 8, in the coordinator's chat: "just ensure that A and B mean the same on the artifact than what you send me otherwise we can reach a problem where the meaning changes from one to the other since they're static and not pointers". Item 436 was checked: chat and page a/b match. Fix: (1) when a question goes to both chat and page, the page item's options are copied from the chat question in the same order, and the chat question names the page item id; (2) a recorded pick stores the label with its letter (for example "b: Keep the rule; archive at merge"), never the letter alone; (3) a check refuses a page item whose label for a key differs from the chat question that cites it. Note: an item's `pick` field is the recommended option, not the answer; the answer lives in the answers collection. Item 436's pick "a" was triage's recommendation; the coordinator set it to b at 12:33 CST, which overwrites the recommendation record.
